# Generated Adapters

This directory contains auto-generated Claude Code runtime adapters.

**DO NOT EDIT FILES IN THIS DIRECTORY.**

These files are generated artifacts. Edit the canonical source package instead:

```text
subagents/<slug>/profile.yaml
```

To regenerate an adapter:

```bash
python -m tools.subagent_factory.cli export <slug>
```

To validate the installed adapter matches canonical:

```bash
python -m tools.subagent_factory.cli validate <slug>
```
